diagnosis: Customer missed events during a two-week outage, but the Webhook delivery replay window is only 7 days per kb-0015. No escalation needed; this is a standard policy limitation.
reply: I understand you want to replay missed events from your recent outage. According to our documentation on webhook delivery failures, events can be manually replayed only within a 7-day window after the original delivery failure. Since your outage lasted two weeks, events older than 7 days are unfortunately no longer available for replay. For events that still fall within that window, please contact our support team and they can assist with the replay process.
